quest.title: In Truth's Steps
quest.description: Bahar from Haravatat seems to be busy with something...

dialogues.speaker: Bahar
dialogues.text: Good day to you, Traveler. Given how you appear, you must be here to take part in the Wisdom Gala, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Bahar
dialogues.text: If you're interested, would you like to try out the event that we, the Haravatat, are organizing?

dialogues.speaker: Bahar
dialogues.text: That is what we research here at Haravatat.

dialogues.speaker: Bahar
dialogues.text: Well, what do you think? Sounds like a good fit for the Gala's festive and relaxed atmosphere, does it not?

dialogues.speaker: Bahar
dialogues.text: Many of my fellow Darshan members do quite think so. Everyone is having fun to their heart's content, so surely we shall not spoil the mood by going around asking people riddles, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Bahar
dialogues.text: In any case, we shall be hard-pressed to drum up much interest if we make people guess riddles for our activity...

dialogues.speaker: Bahar
dialogues.text: After much... friendly discussion, we have decided on a little game known as "In Truth's Steps."

dialogues.speaker: Bahar
dialogues.text: It does not require any tools or items. Just a settled mind and clear thoughts.

dialogues.speaker: Bahar
dialogues.text: When this game starts, I will tell you a story. Now, it may seem to you that the tale is going nowhere. Indeed, some parts of it might even defy common sense!

dialogues.speaker: Bahar
dialogues.text: And so you can question me, to which I will answer using three types of answers: <color=#00E1FFFF>"Yes,"</color> <color=#00E1FFFF>"No,"</color> or <color=#00E1FFFF>"It doesn't matter."</color>

dialogues.speaker: Bahar
dialogues.text: What you need to do is to use your questions to find the "truth" to this story.

dialogues.speaker: Bahar
dialogues.text: Don't be nervous, though. The correct answer isn't meant to be all that complicated.

dialogues.speaker: Bahar
dialogues.text: What do you say? If you're interested, we can start now.

response.speaker: Bahar
response.text: Great! In that case, listen carefully now.

choices.text: I've got something else to do at the moment.

response.speaker: Bahar
response.text: That's alright. I'll be here, and you can come back whenever you'd like to have a go.

dialogues.speaker: Bahar
dialogues.text: (To chase truth's elusive steps... ultimately, it is still a riddle, is it not? *sigh*)
